# Bestest

> A curated used-car marketplace for Orange County, California. Bestest lists only vetted models from franchise-certified dealers — the used cars actually worth buying — and openly excludes the ones it judges not worth the risk. Founded by Jason Allan, former head of vehicle reviews and ratings at Kelley Blue Book and Autotrader.

Bestest is not an aggregator. Every model on the site clears a published curation rubric weighing reliability (measured by repair bills from insurers' California rate filings), resale value, and desirability; dealers must be franchise-certified. Shoppers browse curated inventory near them and reach a dealer through a concierge lead relay — no unsolicited dealer contact. Vehicle listings themselves are transient (cars sell daily) and are intentionally omitted below; the pages here are the durable, high-value ones.

## About Bestest
- [About](https://shopbestest.com/about): Who Bestest is, the founder's background, and why the site exists.
- [Methodology](https://shopbestest.com/methodology): How Bestest scores a car — the reliability, resale, and desirability rubric behind every include/exclude decision, and how the model pages group, rank and count the cars it doesn't list.
- [Coverage area](https://shopbestest.com/coverage-area): The Orange County cities and franchise dealers Bestest covers.

## Models Bestest doesn't list (one page per model: the verdict, the reasons, how it ranks against the listed cars, and what to check if you buy one anyway)
- [Volkswagen Tiguan](https://shopbestest.com/best-used/volkswagen-tiguan): Should you buy a used Volkswagen Tiguan? No. One of the best compact SUVs to drive and one of the hardest to recommend once the warranty runs out; last with Kelley Blue Book among the 13 compact SUVs Bestest scores.
- [Ford Escape](https://shopbestest.com/best-used/ford-escape): Should you buy a used Ford Escape? No. Last of the 13 on five-year resale, reliability in the bottom third of the group (measured by repair bills), and a 1.5-liter fuel-injector defect recalled three times.
- [Chevrolet Equinox](https://shopbestest.com/best-used/chevrolet-equinox): Should you buy a used Chevrolet Equinox? Probably not. Dependable and comfortable, near the bottom of the 13 with Car and Driver and on resale; most two- and three-year-olds on Orange County lots carry fleet-level miles.
- [Nissan Rogue](https://shopbestest.com/best-used/nissan-rogue): Should you buy a used Nissan Rogue? Probably not. Roomy and quiet with the fourth-best reliability of the 13 (measured by repair bills), but the 2022 to 2024 1.5-liter turbo has two engine recalls and the reviews and resale sit below the listed average on every measure.
- [Mitsubishi Outlander](https://shopbestest.com/best-used/mitsubishi-outlander): Should you buy a used Mitsubishi Outlander? Probably not. Much improved since the 2022 redesign on the Rogue's platform, and still among the worst of the 13 at holding its value.
- [GMC Terrain](https://shopbestest.com/best-used/gmc-terrain): Should you buy a used GMC Terrain? Probably not. The cleanest safety record in the group, but last with Car and Driver and Edmunds and 12th of 13 on reliability (measured by repair bills); the most fleet-worn inventory in the segment on Orange County lots.

## Research (studies, guides and data pages)
- [Orange County EV market](https://shopbestest.com/research/orange-county-ev-market): Weekly data page: what's on OC roads, what sold new, and what used EVs cost at local dealers, by price band and model.
- [MyFirstEV eligible cars](https://shopbestest.com/research/myfirstev-eligible-cars): Every new and used EV that qualifies for California's MyFirstEV discount, model by model, checked daily.
- [MyFirstEV used-EV discount: fewer than 40 qualifying cars](https://shopbestest.com/research/myfirstev-used-ev-discount-fewer-than-40): Why so few used EVs qualify for the $1,750 discount.
- [California EV rebates in 2026](https://shopbestest.com/research/california-ev-rebates-stack): Every live California EV rebate, who qualifies, and what stacks.
- [California used-car return rights](https://shopbestest.com/research/california-used-car-return-rights): The three-day return right on used cars bought from a California dealer since October 1, 2026, and how it works.
- [Anaheim's cheap electricity and EV adoption](https://shopbestest.com/research/anaheim-ev-electricity): Where electricity is cheaper in Orange County, EV adoption runs higher.
- [How we calculate city car data](https://shopbestest.com/research/how-we-calculate-city-car-data): Methodology behind the Orange County city pages.

## Machine-readable
- [Curation list (JSON)](https://shopbestest.com/curation.json): Bestest's full nameplate-level curation list for Orange County, updated daily. One record per model: `status` (approved / fun / not_listed / not_recommended), segment and segment URL, scoped exclusions (year, trim, powertrain, engine) with the stated reason, the live count of passing cars for sale (`for_sale_now`, with price_min / price_median), and the pass/fail checklist. Verdict and reason text appears only once approved. CC BY 4.0, attribution "Bestest (shopbestest.com)". The denominator and disclaimer strings ride in the document.
